custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a part number that no part at the test location has, so the new part can be saved.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Inventory Part" window opens.

Step 2:

  • Description shows what you typed.

Step 3:

  • Part Number shows what you typed.

Step 4:

  • Category shows the category you picked.

Step 5:

  • Cost shows 4.00.

Step 6:

  • The switch is off, Min and Max are hidden, and the bin row is still shown.

Step 7:

  • The bin row's Quantity shows 12.

Step 8:

  • The window closes and the part is saved; no bin error appears.

Step 9:

  • One row is listed for the new part: its Bin Location / Quantity cell shows the bin with 12 and its Total Qty cell reads "Not Tracked".

Step 10:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with the switch off, and the Inventory section still holds the bin with Quantity 12.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part)

  • S4-R6: “When the switch is off, the bin location section stays visible and is optional. A bin can be set as a shelf reference without being required to save.”
  • S4-R6a: “The bins set on an untracked part are saved with their quantities, the same as on a tracked part.”
  • S4-R8: “An untracked part shows "Not Tracked" in the Inventory list's Total Qty column instead of a quantity.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
